item.title: Tellus Magnetic — Reduction-to-Pole (RTP) source files
item.subtitle: Geology and Geophysics / GSNI, Tellus
item.description: TMI corrected by reduction-to-pole, which compensates for the dipolar shape of magnetic anomalies caused by NI's inclined magnetic field. RTP places the peak directly above the source body, simplifying interpretation. ±3σ rainbow ramp.

references.label: OSNI Open Data — Tellus Magnetic Grids
